notes.title: LudoNarraCon Streams and New Game Release!
notes.content:
Hi! I'm happy to announce that A YEAR OF SPRINGS will be a part of LudoNarraCon, a digital festival celebrating narrative games! A YEAR OF SPRINGS has its biggest Steam sale yet to celebrate and a demo is also available during the event 🎉

Also, on the exact same day, I'm releasing a new game! The game is [b]A HERO AND A GARDEN[/b], a fantasy visual novel & gardening clicker game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1914740
If you like narrative games, I hope you'll check it out! It's a cute story about a hero, a princess, and a village of monsters. 

The LudoNarraCon event goes from May 5 to May 9, and A YEAR OF SPRINGS will be doing a bunch of streams over this period to take part.

Here's the planned schedule:

[b]May 5:[/b] Art Stream with the Dev (that's me! 👀)
[b]May 6:[/b] Chill Demo Stream (No Commentary)
[b]May 7:[/b] A YEAR OF SPRINGS Music Radio

Streams start every day at [b]4PM PT[/b]! 

You can watch the streams right from this page (I think). Hope to see you there!

notes.title: A HERO AND A GARDEN coming soon to Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41148008/3239c7e2e52cb454c9a8178c31a060150307b701.png[/img]

Hi! I'm going to be releasing another game on Steam called [b]A HERO AND A GARDEN[/b]! It's a gardening visual novel and clicker game that was previously released on consoles, but the Steam version will have a new gameplay mode with remixed BGM. 

You play as a fairytale hero who tried to save a princess but failed miserably and got cursed instead. 

Features:
[list][*]A really useless hero
[*]Monsters who want to be your friend
[*]Monsters who don't want to be your friend
[*]Cute storybook-style art
[*]Unlockable endless mode
[*]Peaceful soundtrack to relax/harvest berries to[/list]
If you liked A YEAR OF SPRINGS, I hope you'll check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1914740/A_HERO_AND_A_GARDEN/

You can also always keep up with news from me by signing up for my newsletter! 
https://www.getrevue.co/profile/npckc

notes.title: 1000 copies sold - thank you! 💜 + future updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41148008/2a6391485abedf3068d3dae1b0c7a7d182b533a8.gif[/img]

Hello! This is npckc, the dev for A YEAR OF SPRINGS. I'm just posting to say thank you because 1000 copies of A YEAR OF SPRINGS have been sold on Steam! I know this isn't a huge number but it's a big milestone for me 💜

I've been working on this game trilogy on and off since 2018 so I'm really happy to be able to share it with more people here. The comments people have made in the reviews are all really lovely too - thank you to everyone who's shared their thoughts on the game. I really appreciate it!

I'm currently working on updates for some translations as well as new translations and I hope I'll be able to release those before the end of the year.

In the meantime, I hope you enjoy A YEAR OF SPRINGS 💐

notes.title: A YEAR OF SPRINGS coming soon to Steam for Tokyo Game Show!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41148008/4272f5d6f0ba2d6eac593e9572cdd990a64d7416.gif[/img]

The visual novel trilogy [b]A YEAR OF SPRINGS[/b] is going to be showcased at TOKYO GAME SHOW 2021 ONLINE! And to participate in the online demo event, the trilogy will also be brought to Steam on September 29! In the demo, you'll be able to play through all of [b]one night, hot springs[/b], the first game in the trilogy. All the art and music was remastered for the trilogy, so definitely check it out if you haven't played yet! 

[url=https://tgs.nikkeibp.co.jp/tgs/2021/exhibition/list.html?lang=ja&grp=%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%87%E3%82%A3%E3%83%BC%E3%82%B2%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0%EF%BC%88%E9%81%B8%E8%80%83%E5%87%BA%E5%B1%95%EF%BC%89]Tokyo Game Show page[/url]

While I didn't originally plan on having the game on platforms other than itch.io, it will be made available here on Steam too. For those of you who previously purchased [b]A YEAR OF SPRINGS[/b] on itch.io up to this date (2021/9/1) and would like a Steam code, please follow the instructions in this post to request a code. While it may take some time for me to get back to you, I will make sure to send out codes by the release date if you contact me before then. 

Code requests: [url=https://npckc.itch.io/a-year-of-springs/devlog/286282/a-year-of-springs-coming-to-steam-for-tokyo-game-show]Instructions & link to contact form[/url]

It's exciting but also scary to be sharing this trilogy on Steam because it's one that's very personal to me and also covers some really sensitive topics, so it'd mean a lot to me if you'd check the page out and wishlist the game so it can reach the people who would like to see it!

Wishlist the game here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1688580
